messages:
lina-support: Jordan from Acme (acct: acme-co-8345) just reported 403 on /billing and 403 on API model calls. Says it started right after this morning's RBAC refactor rollout. Can someone triage?

sam-seceng: on it. Do we have the user email/org and any audit IDs or correlation ids?

lina-support: user jordan@acme.com, org acme-co-8345. Screenshot: https://acme.screens/redacted. Audit entry shows 'role_assignment removed billing for jordan@acme.com' at 2026-03-18T09:04:17Z.

idabot: audit log entry found:
{
  event: "role_removed",
  actor: "deploy-bot",
  target_user: "jordan@acme.com",
  role: "billing",
  ts: "2026-03-18T09:04:17Z",
  change_id: "chg_98f3"
}

sam-seceng: interesting — deploy-bot shouldn't be removing billing. Did the rollout include role mapping rule changes or policy ID renames? Can you paste the policy diff?

lina-support: pasted the rollout policy diff from the deploy: 
```diff
- role: billing
- resources: [billing.console, invoices.read]
+ role: billing
+ resources: [billing.console]
```

sam-seceng: that explains it. invoices.read was intentionally moved into finance.read, but the org-specific mapping rule for acme-co-8345 was accidentally removed. role-mapper v2 treats absent mappings as explicit removals, so it stripped the legacy billing assignment for users that relied on the old mapping.

mike-devops: we can do a quick remediation path: either rollback the role-mapper change or directly regrant the missing role to Jordan. Fastest is a direct grant then follow-up with a rollback/fix.

sam-seceng: agree — do the grant now and then create a rollback and a hotfix. Lina, please do the grant and add an audit note.

lina-support: running: `rbacctl grant --user jordan@acme.com --role billing --scope org:acme-co-8345 --by lina-support`

lina-support: command returned: success (op_id: op_20260318_091202)

idabot: audit log: role_granted by lina-support for jordan@acme.com ts 2026-03-18T09:12:02Z change_ref: op_20260318_091202

jordan-cust: I can access billing and invoices again, thanks. :tada:

sam-seceng: root cause summary (short): role-mapper v2 rollout introduced a new mapping model that treats missing mapping entries as removals. For several orgs (including acme-co-8345) the invoice permission was lost because the mapping for finance.read wasn't created during migration.

sam-seceng: immediate actions: 1) hotfix role-mapper to not delete existing role assignments when a migration mapping is missing (owner: sam-seceng). 2) create and run an integration test that validates role mappings for all existing orgs pre/post-migration (owner: devexp). 3) add a canary threshold to the role-mapper to block changes that would remove roles from >10 users without manual approval (owner: eng-sre). 4) add a README and migration checklist for RBAC migrations (owner: product-iam).

mike-devops: I'll open an internal incident ticket and attach the audit log + op_id. Also will schedule a rollback window if the hotfix needs one.

lina-support: noted. I've emailed Jordan with confirmation and a short explainer and ETA for the postmortem.

sam-seceng: quick note — KMS access was checked and is fine; this was purely RBAC mapping logic, not KMS policy.

lina-support: customer confirmed final: invoices and model API calls are working. Closing once postmortem is published.

reactions: :white_check_mark: :lock_with_key:
